rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-6: ONE knob changed vs the hr-best base iter-3/iter-5 (img_n_bf 5->7, the image-domain bilateral cascade DEPTH); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_05.json (which restored iter-3, img_n_bf=5/img_sr=0.02, hr 0.3320~0.3335 = run-best). Base chosen by HEADROOM, not raw SSIM: hr is the campaign primary metric and is PSNR/noise-sensitive on demo. Trajectory by HEADROOM: iter-1 img_n_bf=1 hr 0.2763 (PSNR 19.47); iter-2 img_n_bf=3 hr 0.3276 (PSNR 20.10, +0.051); iter-3 img_n_bf=5 hr 0.3335 (PSNR 20.18, +0.007 HR-BEST); iter-4 img_sr->0.0005 hr 0.1998 REGRESSED (wrong-direction range-sigma lever, over-sharpen, PSNR 18.60); iter-5 img_sr->0.02 revert hr 0.3320 RECOVERED to ~iter-3. The img_sr range-sigma lever is EXHAUSTED and substrate-confirmed: demo wants LOOSE img_sr=0.02 (opposite to breast), tightening HURTS hr. The proj-domain stack is in the symmetry trap (proj sigmas near-identity per the design doc -> proj_n_bf stays 1, wasted params). That leaves image-domain DEPTH (img_n_bf) as the only proven hr lever on demo, the same lever that earned the whole arc hr 0.276->0.328->0.335. PROBE/HYPOTHESIS: push the proven depth lever one notch further, 5->7, growing the image denoiser from 15 to 21 trainable scalars (total network 16->22 params, still ultra-low, far too few to memorise 6 val scenes). Two more BFs add two coarse-to-fine scales to the multi-scale cascade for additional noise-floor smoothing -- the demo-relevant axis since hr here is PSNR/noise-sensitive. This DOUBLES as the ceiling-doc probe: depth gains are sharply diminishing (1->3 gave +0.051 hr, 3->5 gave only +0.007 hr, PSNR flat 20.10->20.18), so expect <=+0.003 hr. If hr flattens (or regresses), it CONFIRMS demo bilateral N2I is at its structural ceiling (~hr 0.33) -- the 21-scalar image cascade cannot extract more than the half-view FBP noise floor allows on this 128-view synthetic phantom substrate -- and the next iter should stop chasing depth and instead document the ceiling (seed/n_iter/pretrain_epochs invariance probe) rather than tune another smoothing knob. Chose img_n_bf 5->7 over (a) img_sr (exhausted, wrong-direction, hr 0.3335->0.1998), (b) proj_n_bf (symmetry trap, wasted params), (c) img_kernel/img_sx/img_sy (less-informed guesses with no headroom evidence) -- depth is the ONLY lever with a demonstrated positive hr slope on demo. Held fixed at iter-3/iter-5 values: img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, kernels (proj_k=7/img_k=5), proj sigmas (1.0/2.0/0.02), img spatial sigmas (img_sx=1.5/img_sy=1.5), lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 (-> identical val split, directly comparable to iter-1/2/3/4/5). Wall: iter-5 ran 249 s; two more image-domain BFs add only a small fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj per-step cost, so comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (well under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; do NOT revert to amortized.
